name: AI Generator Hub
tagline: Generate AI video from text or photos, plus images, music and voice
description: AI Generator Hub is a web app for people who want several generative media formats without juggling separate subscriptions. You can make a short video from a text prompt or from a still image, and the same account also generates images, music and voice audio. All of these spend one shared credit balance. Pricing: Free $0 with 20 trial credits; Starter $9.9/month; Premium $29.99/month; Enterprise $49.99/month. The interface is available in English and Chinese.
